cohort: The study included two groups of 79 individuals each: children and adolescents diagnosed with T1D (cases) and healthy children and adolescents (controls).
finding: The study found that numerous environmental factors, in addition to genetic predispositions, significantly contribute to the risk of developing Type 1 diabetes.
mod_finding: Delivery method was identified as a significant factor with observed differences between children with Type 1 diabetes and healthy controls.
